title: This chip can become any circuit

captions.text: This chip can become !any circuit! you want.

captions.say: It's called an F P G A.

captions.text: A normal processor's wiring is !fixed forever.!
An FPGA is a sea of tiny *lookup tables,*
captions.say: An F P G A is a sea of tiny lookup tables,

captions.text: each able to act like *any small logic gate,*
Load a file, and those switches turn the chip into *your circuit,*
running many tasks *at once,* in hardware.
and fans rebuild *old game consoles* as real circuits.
Turn most of them off, and they !forget what they were.!
Follow: tomorrow, 60 FPS that still stutters.
captions.say: Follow. Tomorrow: sixty F P S that still stutters.
